```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  
  // Helper function to inject text cleanly above citations
  function addNoteBefore(refId, text) {
    const el = document.getElementById('ref-' + refId);
    if (el) {
      const noteDiv = document.createElement('div');
      noteDiv.style.cssText = "margin-bottom: 5px; color: #000000; font-size: 0.9em; text-indent: 0; padding-left: 0; display: block; font-weight: bold;";
      noteDiv.innerHTML = text;
      el.insertBefore(noteDiv, el.firstChild);
    }
  }

  // Inject your specific notes using the citation keys
  addNoteBefore('Muller_Algavi_Borenstein_2022', 'Microbiome and metabolome data:');
  addNoteBefore('Beaulieu-Jones_Greene_2017', 'Reproducibility and transparency:');
  addNoteBefore('Tommaso_Palumbo_Chatzou_Prieto_Heuer_Notredame_2015', 'Containers:');

});
</script>
```
